harvest_range_basis: assumed +/-25% stage envelope; not sourced bounds

notes: air optimum (18.0, 20.0); review optimum band; no air/core conversion.
Ambient RH not supplied; no humidity adjustment.

induction_actions: Open or cut slits in cultivation bag, lower ambient temperature to 10-16 C, increase fresh air exchange, and introduce indirect light to initiate pinning.
colonisation_cautions: Keep ambient room air cooler (18-20 C) than internal core substrate temperature to prevent metabolic heat buildup above 35 C.
source_reference: Penn State Extension (Royse, 2003); Ten Speed Press (Stamets, 2000), pp. 308-315; ICAR-DMR Solan (2020), p. 24
endpoint_basis: typical consensus duration treated as 90%; +2 days once; range envelope assumed
model_basis: consensus regression plus provisional environmental rules; not experimentally validated
notes: air optimum (18.0, 20.0); review optimum band; no air/core conversion.
Ambient RH not supplied; no humidity adjustment.
Harvest assumes induction starts at the planning marker and suitable fruiting conditions follow.
